name: Timeline
structurePatterns: vertical list of events; each event has a 10px node on the left connected by a 2px subtle vertical line
content to the right: optional timestamp caption, title (body), optional supporting text (body-small)
node color carries status only when the event actually has status meaning
the last event's connector fades or is omitted
usageHints: chronological order must be explicit (newest first or oldest first, labeled if needed)
group long histories by meaningful date or phase boundaries
timeline records event history; it does not replace a task Stepper
status is never conveyed by color alone (icon shape + text)
doNotInvent: no oversized icons replacing the 10px node
